title: Tyler Herro: A Career-High 50 Points in Philadelphia
subheadline: The Wisconsin native's first 50-point game came in his first season with the Bucks, after seven years in Miami.
description: Tyler Herro scored a career-high 50 for the Bucks in Philadelphia on Nov. 21. Why the Milwaukee native's No. 11 Bucks jersey is worth a look this season.
searchIntent: Bucks and NBA fans who saw Herro's 50-point night want the facts behind it and the right No. 11 jersey.
body: Tyler Herro scored a career-high 50 points for Milwaukee in Philadelphia on Nov. 21. He made 15 of 23 shots, 7 of 12 threes and all 13 of his free throws, and added 11 rebounds and seven assists.
His previous best was 41, set against Houston in December 2022. A last-second three that would have forced overtime was ruled to have left his hand after the buzzer, and the Bucks fell 132-129.
## Why fans are buying in

The result stung, but the night belonged to Herro. He scored 15 points in three different quarters and became only the seventh player to put up 50 for the Bucks, joining a list led by Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

The story behind it is what makes his jersey interesting. Herro grew up in the Milwaukee area and played high school ball at Whitnall in Greenfield, Wisconsin. After seven seasons with the Heat, he came home this summer in the trade that sent Antetokounmpo to Miami. A local kid stepping into the spot left by a franchise icon is the kind of fresh start fans tend to rally around.

His résumé backs it up. Herro, 26, has averaged more than 20 points in each of the last five seasons and was an All-Star in 2025. In our analysis, a career night like this is a reminder that Milwaukee has a scorer to build around, even with the team off to a 1-16 start.
## The look

The banner above shows his No. 11 in the Bucks' hunter green Icon Edition, the deep green home look the franchise is known for. It is a clean, classic jersey for a player many Wisconsin fans watched long before he reached the NBA.
## Why this jersey will last

Herro is under contract through this season, so how he finishes it will shape the next chapter in Milwaukee. The Bucks visit Toronto on Monday.
